notes: Returns the top eligible task assigned to the agent persona (tag agent:<persona>, or assigned to an agent actor) inside the token's subtree, or {"task": null} when nothing is eligible. Eligible: id matches the published id_pattern; open, not archived, not on hold, not done-provisional; no open dependency; no open child task (a question's own subtask counts only through its ask); no unanswered blocking ask, in the thread or as a subtask; spent below the allowance in both units; lease free or held by this session. Ranked by effective_priority (lower first; null means none set) then outline order. Takes a 90-minute lease for session; any call carrying the task with the same session renews it, and next_task re-issues it to that session. action is the task's next action, body its notes. allowance is the task's own, else its nearest ancestor's, else {windows} from the owner's budget tier for the effective priority, else null until the owner's client has posted its Strategy choices. spent: tokens = input + output + cache_write, cache_read apart (never counted against an allowance), windows = the larger of the reported windows and the 5-hour windows in which usage arrived. hardDeadline is the nearest one on the task or above. latest_start (ms) is the latest finish the web core derives from hard deadlines (on the task, above it or on a task it blocks) less the task's planning minutes; absent when no hard deadline reaches the task. defaults_allowed is the owner's Strategy default-on-silence choice for the effective priority's tier, false until posted. See next_task_claim.json for claiming a specific task.
